about: Norwich is a township in Oxford County, Ontario, southeast of Woodstock—not a city. The village of Norwich, Otterville, and surrounding dairy and tobacco-belt farmland share a rural southwestern Ontario landscape. About 11,000 people live in Norwich Township.
seoSummary: Oxford County township of Norwich and Otterville—dairy and farm country southeast of Woodstock, not a city.
